<includeonly><templatestyles src="Template:Progression graph/styles.css" />{{#invoke:Erenshor/Progression|graph}}</includeonly><noinclude>Shows the route to a target as chapters of numbered steps, from [[Module:Erenshor/Progression]] and [[Module:Erenshor/Data/Progression]]. Place <code><nowiki>{{Progression graph}}</nowiki></code> on a zone, quest, item, or character page that identifies one entity. On a shared page, pass the intended <code>stablekey</code>.

For example, <code><nowiki>{{Progression graph|stablekey=zone:braxonia}}</nowiki></code> shows the route to Fallen Braxonia. On a page without an entity, the template shows the routes to the four raid planes.

The steps are one order of play from a new character's start, not level or difficulty advice or your character's progress. Each step names one way in a plain sentence. Chapters end at the areas and gates that the route opens, and a long chapter is split at its quests. Other ways, and where to get what a step needs, can be expanded under each step. With JavaScript, a map of the chapters of one goal appears above the route.

The text works without JavaScript. Report a missing or incorrect requirement at [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data]]. Keep handwritten strategy and walkthroughs unchanged.</noinclude>
